items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Eldridge Towers, that musician right there. [INTERVIEWEE] He was at the head of the band at that particular time.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. I forgot about the jizznit dances. Whose band was that? That was Talbert.
Eldridge Towers, that musician right there.
He was at the head of the band at that particular time.
